question.text: What is the settlement method for all exchange-traded currency futures and options in India?

answer.text: Either cash or physical at the trader's choice

explanation.text: The Logic: All exchange-traded currency futures and option contracts in India are currently cash settled in Indian Rupees (pp. 51-52, 166). Only the profit/loss is exchanged, not the underlying currencies. The Trap: OTC forwards may be physically delivered, but exchange-traded currency contracts are always cash settled in INR. Note: Because settlement is in INR, actual importers/exporters still rely on the OTC/spot market for physical currency delivery (p. 60).
